lines: A series of primary schools has been set for construction across Aldok after census reports revealed a lowered literacy rate since the last war.

While more labor jobs post-war are to be expected, the People's Government has long pushed for a more equitable and educated future, with an increase in libraries and technical universities set to be constructed in each province.

In addition, historians, mathematicians, and schoolteachers are being commissioned by Our Government to create updated child-friendly history books, math books, and other educational material to support our future generations.
Our Lady Serebryakova, in her latest speech, called it "a worthy investment in the future of our children".
